reasoning: The evidence shows that as of 2025, no Group A streptococcal vaccine has been approved or licensed. Multiple sources confirm vaccines are still in development: snippet 2 states vaccines are 'currently getting close or becoming clinical studies' with the 30-valent and J8 vaccines in early stages. Snippet 4 indicates a phase 1/2 trial completed in May 2025, with StreptInCor expected to run until 2028. Snippet 1 notes that as of 2020, 'a safe one had not yet been developed' despite 20+ years of work. The resolution date is November 2, 2025—only 6 months away. Given that leading candidates are still in phase 1/2 trials with phase 3 not yet started, and considering typical vaccine development timelines (phase 3 trials alone take 1-3+ years), it is highly unlikely a vaccine will be developed, approved, and documented on Wikipedia by November 2025. The evidence suggests development is progressing but remains years away from completion.
